race.comment: ROADCONE (1) resumes. His form is strong for this, hence he's assigned top weight. He's won fresh in the past and 1450m is a good kick off point. He does typically improve into a campaign but if he brings anything like his best he'll go close from the inside gate. SHAALUTE (3) won at Geelong BM78 over Desert Anthem and has the race fitness edge, with a better Bendigo run than his seventh suggests after settling too far back. REGAL TYCOON (7) is close to a win after a long-neck second at Kyneton and a close third at Cranbourne, now dropping in weight. ROMANTIC ENCOUNTER (5) was disappointing behind SHAALUTE as favourite, but racing three-wide without cover is a valid excuse, and first-time blinkers from a good gate suggest he can bounce back. MAKE IT SWEET (10) can run well fresh.
